newsitem.title: FRANCE: French new car sales fall 9.7 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: French new car sales fall 9.7 pct in July.

text.p: New car sales in France fell 9.7 percent in July from year-earlier levels to 211,747 units, the French carmakers committee CCFA said on Friday.
On a comparable day basis -- there were 22 working days last month compared with 23 in July 1996 -- the fall was 5.6 percent, it said in a statement.
PSA Peugeot Citroen car sales in France fell 7.6 percent, while Renault SA car sales rose 4.1 percent. The French carmakers had 57.6 percent of the market in July.
For the first seven months of the year, new car sales were down 21.1 percent in France at 996,265 units.
